name: Chart
intent: ECharts-backed chart widget that owns the chart instance lifecycle, responsive resizing, and canvas-safe translation of Core semantic tokens.
when: Render any of the chart-family examples

chooseOver.because: Chart/ChartContainer is the base for authored visualizations; CoreChartRenderer interprets AI-generated chart payloads.

commonMistakes.mistake: Passing raw var(...) or oklch(...) strings directly to ECharts series colors
commonMistakes.symptom: Axes render but lines, bars, or markers are invisible in canvas output
commonMistakes.fix: Use createThemedChartOption with semantic tones or colorIndex values; ChartContainer also normalizes nested color fields.
commonMistakes.avoidOverride: Do not pass unresolved CSS Color 4 values to canvas/ECharts color fields.

ownership.expectedWrapper: A sized content region or chart card; ChartContainer does not own a card surface.

usage: Use Chart to display structured data or visualizations. This component helps users understand and interact with complex information sets.

Chart is ideal for dashboards, reports, and data-heavy interfaces. Ensure data is presented clearly and consider responsive behavior for different screen sizes. Provide appropriate loading states for async data.

anatomy.description: Chart is composed of the following parts:

bestPractices.title: Use semantic props
bestPractices.description: Use the component's built-in props rather than className overrides.

bestPractices.title: Don't override core styles
bestPractices.description: Avoid using className to override the component's fundamental styling.

bestPractices.title: Provide accessible labels
bestPractices.description: Include proper ARIA labels for screen reader users.

bestPractices.title: Don't skip accessibility
bestPractices.description: Never omit accessibility attributes for interactive components.

bestPractices.title: Handle all states
bestPractices.description: Account for loading, error, empty, and success states.

bestPractices.title: Don't ignore edge cases
bestPractices.description: Avoid showing broken UI when data is missing or loading.
